note: Generated ambient loops used by the web surfaces. Each entry records the prompt, model and encode so a clip can be reproduced. Clips are forward-only; a ping-pong reverse reads as an obvious stop at each turn. The 6 s wrap is hidden by crossfading the last 1.5 s into the first 1.5 s (SSIM first-vs-last ~0.95), so the loop dissolves instead of cutting.
